label: Gear Trader

offers.label: Sniper rifle
offers.about: a long black rifle that hits dead on at 100 m; weapon 4

note: IP-neutral. Market stall: the legal shop (the fence is the other side of the market: contraband, bounties, his armour). Pays buy_rate x item value for gear and sells what it holds at sell_rate x value, so anything sold to it can be bought back. 'endless_stock': what it always has and never runs out of, at sell_rate x value: jetpacks (one each time; a jetpack sold to it does not pile up). Issues #208, #209: 'offers' it sells from a menu (src/systems/items/gear_upgrades.gd): gun and jetpack upgrades, each once (factors on paths in the target's data), and the sniper rifle ('endless': he never runs out of it).
